prompt: Isometric game environment, elevated 45-degree view with clear spatial depth. An ordinary roadside bus stop in an old working-class neighborhood of a small northeastern Chinese town, on a summer night. A narrow asphalt road runs beside a weathered metal bus shelter, corrugated roof and wooden bench, low plaster wall, utility pole, sparse weeds along the curb, glimpses of modest brick housing beyond. The shelter belongs to a continuous lived-in neighborhood, ordinary wear, asymmetrical spacing.
